proposal.observation: Canonical orientation is healthy, but the centreline recentring residual is 20.8 cm and the unrolled map has a pronounced asymmetric void and radial gradient at the left boundary plus irregular lower-boundary loss. The global NaN fraction is not extreme for this family, while denoising retains about 69% of points. Detection uses fallback exclusively; its ten propagated prompts are regular and match the expected count, so downstream Hough and SAM tuning would currently be weakly identifiable.
proposal.failure_mode: Primary: stage-1 centre-curve underfit or contaminated fit causing off-centre unrolling and spatially nonuniform radial-band loss (f_curve_overfit, specifically under-fit), with secondary depth holes and incomplete segmentation coverage. Orientation is not implicated, and the all-fallback detector is treated as a downstream consequence rather than the first tuning target.
proposal.rationale: Round 1 should address the earliest visible defect. A cubic centre curve can represent curvature that a quadratic fit leaves as the measured 20.8 cm residual, while a tighter RANSAC threshold should reject displaced slice centres instead of absorbing them into the curve. The denoising gates are reset to the T3 priors so the revised unroll is evaluated with the family-supported radial and circumferential support rather than compensating for centreline error by broadly widening the band. Detection and SAM parameters remain unchanged until centreline residual and spatial coverage improve.
